name: Article landscape
layout: Place the character and one concrete metaphor across the middle 40-60% of the canvas. Keep at least 35% calm negative space. The character must physically cause, repair, move, sort or inspect the central relationship.
text_policy: Prefer no generated text. If the user explicitly requests integrated labels, use at most one short phrase and keep it secondary to the visual action.
constraints: Use a true horizontal composition, not a crop from a square or portrait image.
Preserve every continuity anchor from the supplied profile.
Express one content judgment with one main physical metaphor.
Keep the image suitable for inline article reading on a phone.
Do not include calls to action, codes, logos or watermarks.
negative_prompt: character used as a corner sticker
